note: Answers Zapper's 'forget about Zephal' (end of slice 004); Mirco is cut off mid-word, kept as an interruption.

en:
"Hey, Mircooo...{w}Hurry up and get strong,
and ride on my back, okay?"{w}
note: Zapper is a griffon (row 794): 'ride on my back'. Editorial: 'climb up on' -> 'ride on' (noru; matches Zapper's 'ride on my back' in slice 002, row 334).

en: "'Cause I'm waitin' for ya.{w}My reins are there just for you, y'know?{w}You get that part, riiight?"{w}
note: Editorial: 'y'know' was used twice in a row; first tag now carries the kara-saa ('cause).

en:
"I get it...
I mean, snuggling up to me like this..."{w}
note: Editorial: source trails off (-te koraretemo); kept as a trailing complaint instead of a completed sentence.

en:
"Then train harder, c'mooon~"{w}{p}"Or else yours truly might go and become
somebody else's griffon, y'know?{w}Is that okay? Is it, huh?"{w}
note: Zapper's self-reference switches to 'ore-sama' here: 'the great me'. Editorial: 'the great me might' read ungrammatically; 'yours truly' keeps the self-aggrandising ore-sama.

en:
"T-too close, you're too close...
Hey! Zapper!?"{w}

note: Music note dropped (ASCII only); the sing-song tone is carried by the tildes.
Music note dropped (ASCII only).

en: The two of them ran off.{w}

"What a strange place this is. Well then, perhaps I too...
shall go looking for a spring that's come a little late, eh!?{w}Ho ho ho!!"{w}
note: 'A late spring' = a late-in-life romance; the image is kept rather than explained.
anesan = 'big sis' (Elpina's name for Gurtia). Editorial: anesan = 'Sis', the form used for Elpina -> Gurtia in slices 001-004 and 058.
Kiss sound; music note dropped (ASCII only).
Source says she flew away (tobisatte).

en:
"Huff, huff, huff...
I finally got away!!{w}Gurtia, are you okay?"{w}
note: 'Shook [Zapper] off': object left implicit to avoid a pronoun for Zapper (gender unknown).

en: "Y-yes.{w}I'm fine, and yet somehow not fine...{w}I see you made it through unharmed, young master."{w}
note: bocchama = 'young master', used as a third-person address to Mirco.

en:
"Honestly, everyone's doing whatever they want
just because it's a dream."{w}{p}"I noticed while I was running,
these clothes seem to have gotten
a little small on me."{w}
"Oh, so they have. You're a growing boy, after all."{w}

"Will you make me new clothes again?{w}I could have some sent from home,
but I'd rather have clothes you sewed for me, Gurtia."{w}

note: Editorial: 'Yes' + negative read awkwardly.
Gurtia's thoughts in parentheses, as in the source.

en: "This time, so they'll hold up even when I move around a lot..."{w}
note: Mirco keeps talking about the clothes while Gurtia thinks; rows 832-838 interleave. Editorial: clarity; the clothes must be OK (daijoubu) even when he moves about; leads into 'sturdy' in 836.

en: "Something sturdy and easy to move in..."{w}
(And whatever I do, nobody will remember it once they wake up...){w}
note: Subject 'I' restored: Gurtia applies Zephal's 'no memory after waking' idea to herself. Accuracy: the source (oboetenai to) gives no subject 'I'; it picks up the 'nobody will remember' idea from rows 764-772 (slice 004), so the point is that Mirco won't remember what she does, not that she won't.

Muttered tail of the line spelled out in row 846 (...e ba ii noni); kept as a fragment that starts mid-sentence. Accuracy: the source mutter keeps only the clipped end of the verb plus the wish (...e ba ii noni); 'die' itself is inaudible and Mirco only asks what's wrong. '...ie' = the clipped end of 'die', revealed in row 846. Editorial may polish the wording, but should not spell out 'die' here.

en: "Master Mirco, I wish you'd just die."{w}
note: Not softened: 'shinjaeba ii noni' = 'I wish you'd just die'.

en:
"I hope House Lenzer loses its heir
and falls to ruin!!"{w}
note: Accuracy: shimaeba ii no yo is an active wish, not indifference; 'for all I care' softened it.

en: Gurtia pinched Mirco's cheeks with both hands!{w}

note: Mirco's lines 853-869 are mangled speech with pinched cheeks; rendered as slurred English of the likely words.
'Mirco-sama nante' (dismissive 'you and your...') trails off; kept unfinished.
Slurred 'itai! itai yo!?' (It hurts!).
Slurred 'yamete yo, Gurtia!' (Stop it, Gurtia!).

en:
(What a pathetic noise to make!
For a brat like this, I...!!){w}
note: Not softened: gaki = 'brat'. Editorial: 'for the sake of' too formal for her angry inner outburst.
Inarticulate pinched-cheek noises; no clear word behind them.
Slurred 'yamete' (stop).
She is lifting Mirco (row 880).

en: (Even so, I'm the one who raised him, aren't I... this child...){w}
note: Editorial: brings out the rueful self-questioning of the source's -no ka (accuracy suggestion).

en: Gurtia picked Mirco up in her arms.{w}

"P-put me down, this is embarrassing!{w}Pinching me, picking me up...
have you gone weird too, Gurtia!?"{w}
"...Weird?{w}Yes, I suppose. Perhaps I have.{w}Hee hee hee!"{w}
note: Editorial: Gurtia's ufufu laugh = 'Hee hee hee' as in slices 001 and 004 (rows 239, 285, 702).
gaan = shocked dismay.

en: "For a little while...{w}um, would you walk with me, just the two of us?{w}Shall we explore? This place, I mean. ...Won't you?"{w}
"J-just so you know!{w}Geez. I'm not a kid, okay!?"{w}
note: Source has an odd full stop inside 'mou. kodomo ja nai'; kept as a flustered stammer. Accuracy: the full stop makes 'mou.' read as the exasperated interjection 'Geez' (as in row 907), not 'anymore'; the stammer 'I'm not. A kid' was not in the source. If the stop is a source typo, 'I'm not a kid anymore, okay!?' also works.

en: "My apologies.{w}Hee hee. Please don't be cross."{w}
note: Editorial: Gurtia's laugh aligned with her 'Hee hee hee' (see row 884).
Short label (op096), likely a trap/tile name shown in a box; kept short.

en: But you are floating in midair{w}
note: Follows the 'Pit' label: the party does not fall.
No {w} in source; none added. 'Hikkakatta' = snagged/caught in a trap; the ??? voice echoes it in row 919.
Glossary.
Echoes row 917 (hikkakatta = got caught / fell for it).

en:
Your bodies would no longer obey you,
and you were dragged off somewhere!!{w}
Where's my ball... Where's my baaall...{w}

note: Banner; full-width spaces as two ASCII spaces.
Glossary.

en: "Fooound youuu!{w}My cute little baaalls!!{w}C'mon, c'mon! Let's play some golf, huh!?"{w}{p}"Kyeeehhh!!"{w}
note: tamatama-chan: 'balls' keeps the source's double entendre (tama = ball / testicles); the party are the golf balls (next slice: 'Nice shot!!').

en: The Clown Doll raised the club high!{w}
